title: VFR Departure from Runway City Airport

atis.atc: Runway City Airport information Alpha. Time one-four-five-five Zulu. Wind one-eight-zero at one-zero. Visibility one-zero. Sky clear. Temperature two-two, dew point one-zero. Altimeter two-niner-niner-two. Landing and departing Runway One Eight. Advise on initial contact you have information Alpha.

pilot.prompt: Call Runway City Ground. You are at the FBO ramp and want to taxi to Runway 18 for a VFR departure to the north. Include all four parts: who you're calling, who you are, where you are, and what you want.

required.value: NOVEMBER ONE TWO THREE FOXTROT SIERRA

pilot.example: Runway City Ground, Cessna November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, FBO ramp, request taxi to Runway One Eight, VFR departure to the north.

ground_clearance.atc: November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, Runway City Ground, taxi to Runway One Eight via Charlie, Alpha, hold short of Runway Zero Niner Two Seven, altimeter two niner niner two.

pilot.prompt: Read back the taxi clearance. Required items: runway assigned, hold-short instruction, altimeter setting, and your callsign.

required.value: NOVEMBER ONE TWO THREE FOXTROT SIERRA

pilot.example: Taxi Runway One Eight via Charlie, Alpha, hold short Runway Zero Niner Two Seven, altimeter two niner niner two, November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra.

pilot.prompt: You have taxied to the Runway 18 hold-short line. Contact Runway City Tower. Report who you are, your position, that you have information Alpha, and that you are ready for departure.

required.value: NOVEMBER ONE TWO THREE FOXTROT SIERRA

pilot.example: Runway City Tower, Cessna November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, holding short Runway One Eight, information Alpha, ready for departure VFR northbound.

takeoff_clearance.atc: November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, Runway City Tower, Runway One Eight, cleared for takeoff, wind one-eight-zero at one-zero. Fly runway heading, departure frequency one-two-four-point-zero passing two thousand.

pilot.prompt: Read back the takeoff clearance. Required items: runway assignment and departure frequency.

required.value: NOVEMBER ONE TWO THREE FOXTROT SIERRA

pilot.example: Cleared for takeoff Runway One Eight, departure one-two-four-point-zero, November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra.

pilot.prompt: You have climbed through 2,000 feet. Contact Runway City Departure on 124.0. Report your callsign, aircraft type, altitude climbing through, and your VFR destination.

required.value: NOVEMBER ONE TWO THREE FOXTROT SIERRA

pilot.example: Runway City Departure, Cessna November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, climbing through two thousand, VFR northbound.

complete.atc: November One Two Three Foxtrot Sierra, Runway City Departure, radar contact. Squawk four-five-two-one. Maintain VFR, frequency change approved, good day.
